title: Rock, Paper, Scissors
description: After being released, a reformed serial killer moves into his family's ancestral estate and is haunted by his past -- both the living and the dead.

title: Assassin's Game
description: After a team of assassins messes up a hit, Vet Jones' former boss asks him to kill the target or his son will die.

title: Hirokin: The Last Samurai
description: A warrior leads an uprising against the tyrannical ruler of the planet Aradius.

title: The Rules of Attraction
description: Based on the novel by Bret Easton Ellis, "Rules" centers around Patrick Bateman's younger brother and his college friends' bizarre mating rituals that mix sex, drugs, music and mayhem in a kaleidoscopic story about three students entangled in a curiously surreal romantic triangle...

title: Phobic
description: A fragile homicide detective sees similarities between herself and the victims of a killer who is murdering phobics by exposing them to their fears.

title: Joyride
description: Three excitement-craving friends get more than they bargained for when they steal a hit woman's automobile.

title: Death Defying Acts
description: Upon arriving in Edinburgh, Scotland for a series of mind-boggling performances, master illusionist Harry Houdini (Guy Pearce) offers an impressive cash reward to any supposed psychic who can accurately tell him his late mother's exact last words. Gorgeous swindler Mary McGarvie (Catherine Zeta-Jones) rises to the challenge and engages Houdini in a dangerous flirtation that will blur the line between reality and paranoia -- and test the very limits of his skepticism.

title: At Middleton
description: Though adversaries at first, romantic sparks begin to fly between a surgeon (Andy Garcia) and a retailer (Vera Farmiga) during a college tour with their teenage offspring.

title: Youth in Oregon
description: When 79-year-old curmudgeon Raymond (Frank Langella) makes arrangements to be euthanized in Oregon, his family refuses to accept his decision. But when another family emergency arises, Raymond's daughter Kate (Christina Applegate) turns to her husband, Brian (Billy Crudup), for a little help. So Brian reluctantly volunteers to drive the cantankerous Raymond and his wine-loving wife, Estelle (Mary Kay Place), to Oregon.

title: Night Raiders
description: In a post-war future, a mother joins an underground band of vigilantes to try and rescue her daughter from a state-run institution.

title: Slayer
description: A soldier (Casper Van Dien) must hunt down his best friend (Kevin Grevioux) after a vampire bites the man and turns him into one of the undead.

title: Puncture Wounds
description: A war veteran (Cung Le) incurs the wrath of a ruthless Aryan Brotherhood leader (Dolph Lundgren) after he kills several high-ranking members while rescuing a prostitute.

title: Shanghai Calling
description: An attorney from New York is sent to Shanghai on business and soon finds himself in trouble with the law.

title: Dragon Eyes
description: Hong (Cung Le) uses his moral vision and fighting skills to save a neighborhood in St. Jude from drug dealers and corrupt cops.

title: Still Waiting ...
description: When a competing eatery steals their customers, restaurant employees hatch a raunchy plan to drum up business.

title: Interrogation
description: An FBI interrogator (Adam Copeland) and an IT specialist (C.J. Perry Barnyashev) have to play a criminal mastermind's mind games as they race to uncover his true agenda.

title: John Henry
description: A quiet man with a violent past has his life changed when an immigrant girl who is on the run from gang violence in South Los Angeles stumbles into his life.

title: Fisherman's Friends: One and All
description: Following the unexpected success of their debut album, members of the musical group Fisherman's Friends struggle with the pressures, pitfalls and temptations of their newfound fame.

title: Ex-Husbands
description: Manhattan dentist Peter Pearce is facing a midlife crisis after his wife of 35 years leaves him. On the spur of the moment, he books a trip to Tulum, Mexico, only to crash his son's bachelor party.
